text: Mrs Heather's work speaks for itself! Her paint work is INCREDIBLE. Not only does she paint the pose YOU want with the background YOU want. She makes an experience out of the evening by having a beautiful display setup and (should you be okay with it) records your first reaction to the painting. She also has the tradition of bride and groom doing a brush stroke on the painting. In my particular scenario, i hired Mrs Heathers services as my wifes wedding gift (which was a surprise.) She was so sweet and easy to work with, she gets as many details as possible to make the painting EXACTLY what you and your spouse's vision is for your wedding day painting is. I cant say enough great things about her attitude, her devotion to each project, and the care she takes throughout the process to ensure your vision is brought to life via her wonderful paintings. I will certainly be in contact with Mrs Heather again for future meaninful paintings. Thank you so much for such a lovely painting and wonderful experience at our wedding!! - The Purkels
